note: The limit is the free stress `T.J` of the lighthouse `T`, whose sign is fixed by `FreeDiv`, rather than a Lean object named T^Max, and `produce_current` assumes the stable weak comparison and `FreeDiv` as hypotheses.

def meter (p : Scaling S) (B : S.Stress) (B0 : (Bel L).Stress) := ∀ i j,Tendsto
    (fun k => (p.U k 4).symm ((↑((p.xi k)⁻¹*p.r k^4):ℂ) • B i j)) atTop (𝓝 (B0 i j))

proof_context.conclusion: `p.meter B B0` says that for all i, j the entry `(p.U k 4).symm ((xi k)⁻¹ * r k^4 • B i j)` tends to `B0 i j`, with `p.xi k > 0` from `sign`.

theorem produce_current (H : S.Hierarchy) (hW : W.Derivatives S) (ho : W.Orientation H.spin)
    (a : (Bel C.book).Hierarchy) (T : Lighthouse C.book) (hV : T.W.Derivatives (Bel C.book)) (p : T.W.Orientation a.spin)
    (hT : FreeDiv T a p) (X : Scaling S) (hp : Approaches (path X) (isoPanel X)) (h : Stable H.spin a.spin W T.W X) :
    ∃ J : KernelSpace H.spin,∃ Y : Scaling S,J.val ≠ 0 ∧ currentDiv W H.spin ho J=0 ∧
      Approaches (path Y) (isoPanel Y) ∧ Stable H.spin a.spin W T.W Y ∧ Y.meter J.val T.J := by

proof_context.conclusion: `produce_current` produces a nonzero divergence-free J and a refinement Y of the scaling with `Y.meter J.val T.J`, the componentwise limit to the free stress `T.J`.
